blocks.text: SITHEHR is a comprehensive Hospital Management and Records System (HMR) built for multi-tenant hospital operations. It covers the full patient journey - from public self-service appointment booking, patient registration, outpatient and emergency encounters, inpatient and ICU admission, operating room scheduling, laboratory and radiology services, pharmacy and medical supply dispensing, billing and payments, PhilHealth claims, medical certificate generation, specialty care (OB, delivery, renal/dialysis), primary care (YAKAP), and complete administrative back-office (master data, user/role management, audit logging, and reporting).

runs.text: (1) Multi-tenancy - each hospital is a tenant with isolated data scope; (2) Soft deletes - records are deactivated via a history flag (history=1 = active), never physically removed; (3) Audit trail - every create and update logs created_by/created_date and updated_by/updated_date; (4) JWT authentication stored in an HTTP-only cookie; (5) Permission-based route protection - every page requires a specific permission (e.g. permission:lab.manage); (6) PDF reporting via Barryvdh DomPDF for invoices, receipts, statements of account, PhilHealth claim forms, lab/radiology results, ER EECL, and medical certificates; (7) Public appointment booking at /book-appointment - the only route accessible without login.

PHP 8.2.12 on XAMPP, Laravel 12 framework, Livewire 4 for reactive server-side components, Tailwind CSS v4 for styling, Alpine.js for lightweight client interactivity, Barryvdh DomPDF for PDF generation, tymon/jwt-auth for token-based authentication, phpoffice/phpspreadsheet for spreadsheet exports. Frontend assets are built with Vite and published to public/build/ (run npm run build after frontend changes).
